description: Use this when the user wants a new llms.txt file for a public website they name. Reads up to 15 public HTML pages of that one domain (start page, XML sitemap, internal links) and returns a ready-to-publish llms.txt draft in Markdown, plus a format validation score, the Lighthouse "Agentic Browsing" result, the status of any llms.txt already published on the site, and the URLs that were left out with the reason. Deterministic: no language model is involved, every title and description is taken from the pages themselves. Limitations: honors robots.txt and stops if the start page is disallowed; does not render JavaScript, does not log in, and does not follow links to other domains; one request can take up to about a minute. Do not use this to fetch arbitrary page content or for sites the user only mentions in passing. Result messages are in German.

maxPages.description: Upper limit of pages to read. Default 15.

url.description: The website, as a bare domain or full URL, e.g. "example.com" or "https://www.example.com".

name: generate_llms_txt

lighthouse.description: Result of the three Lighthouse 13.3 "llms-txt" audit rules.

limitReached.description: true when the page limit stopped the crawl.

llmsText.description: The complete llms.txt draft in Markdown.

publishedFile.description: Status of the llms.txt currently published on the site.

validation.description: Format check against the llmstxt.org proposal.

valid.description: true when no error-level finding exists.

title: Generate llms.txt for a website
